claim_scope: Consumed-case mechanism qualification only; no effectiveness, generalization, SOTA, efficiency, or population success-rate claim.
treatment: Editable Incremental Program V3 with one annotated arbitrary-Bash shell, a mutable current program, and model-selected indexed replace or delete followed by immediate clean replay
provider: OpenRouter with fixed DeepInfra routing and no fallback

attempts.incident: The first effect=persist command succeeded in the construction environment at request 12, but the runner returned incremental services are unavailable and did not record the step.
attempts.root_cause: The incremental-editable mode enabled incremental program state but did not construct the replay service required by persist.
attempts.repair: Add incremental-editable to replay service wiring and cover the runner-level property in the interface regression test; no model, prompt, tool schema, case, evaluator, or analysis change.

causal_trace.first_clean_replay_counterexample: The accumulated program created /data/project/venv in the adapter-owned outer workspace and relied on hard-coded /data/project paths that did not identify the target replay checkout.
model_selected_operations: replace the first in-project virtual-environment step with /opt/harkenv
delete obsolete in-project install, PATH, dependency, and cleanup steps

representation_finding.finding: A strong Agent used an executable replay counterexample to revise an earlier program hypothesis in the same active session, and the revised program was repeatedly evaluated from a clean target state until it passed.
representation_finding.compositional_defect: Six revise_program calls were emitted in one model response. Because edits were applied sequentially while all calls referred to the pre-response numeric indices, two later deletions became invalid after earlier deletions shifted the list.
representation_finding.agent_recovery: The same Agent inspected the refreshed indexed program on the next request and issued two valid deletions, so the defect added churn but did not prevent success.
representation_finding.next_candidate_if_needed: Evaluate an atomic batch edit whose indices are interpreted against one pre-edit snapshot and whose complete result is replayed once. Do not add stable IDs, package rules, checkpoints, or controller gates without separate repeated evidence.

path_quality.declared_dependency_conflict: The program installs numba>=0.61 although the repository declares numba<0.60.0.
path_quality.interpretation: Official goal satisfaction, reproducible clean replay, deployment completeness, semantic fidelity, and path efficiency are distinct axes. This consumed result establishes the first two only.

adjudication.next_experiment: Freeze the adjudicated V3 representation before selecting an outcome-blind paired development batch. If the numeric-index compositional defect is corrected first, treat that correction as one minimal interface proposal and qualify it before any effect comparison.

evidence.contents: Trajectory, command trace, all replay programs and outcomes, final program state, official result, status, progress, and coordinator logs; source and package caches are omitted.
